title: evidence-hacklog-jin-2026
content:
Purpose: quick, messy record of evidence hunting heuristics and POC commands for SOC2 control mapping. Not formalized — personal hacklog.

Context: prepping for Type II; most ask areas we keep hitting: access logging, key management (KMS/HSM), deployment isolation (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), change control for model serving runtime, observability retention and traces, and incident response timelines.

Quick heuristics (what auditors usually want):
- Show a reproducible artifact for each control: config file + one-line command to extract evidence + human explanation of why this proves the control.
- Prefer immutable records (CloudTrail, S3 object versions, signed export) over hand-written notes.
- Cross-link evidence to Jira/PR when change-control is involved.

Candidate control->artifact mappings (working):
- CC-AccessMgmt-01: IAM role assignment audit
  - Artifact: aws://cloudtrail/events?filter=CreateRole OR AttachRolePolicy (time window) + snapshot of role json -> s3://redwood-evidence/iam/roles-2026-02-13.json
  - Command: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=CreateRole --start-time 2026-01-01 --end-time 2026-02-14
  - Note: need to redact ARNs from hosted customer ids; present a filtered view.

- CC-ConfigMgmt-03: change control for serving runtime (model rollout)
  - Artifact: GitHub PR link + deployment rollout log from console (trace id) + canary metrics snapshot
  - PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/481 (adds kernel selector tweak)
  - Console trace id example: trace=tr-20260211-7f9b (grab span showing rollout trigger)

- CC-KeyMgmt-02: KMS usage and HSM integration for Private deployments
  - Artifact: KMS key policy snapshot + CloudWatch KMS usage logs + HSM attestation (if used by customer on-prem)
  - Command: aws kms list-keys; aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <id> > key-policy.json

- CC-Logging-04: log retention and tamper evidence
  - Artifact: S3 object version history + CloudTrail for PutObject/DeleteObject + lifecycle policy json
  - Tip: export S3 access logs to a separate bucket with versioning and lifecycle 'retain-7y' for audit.

Evidence extraction notes (practical):
- Keep one reproducible extraction script per control (bash/python); auditors ask to rerun or verify artifact lineage.
- Use ephemeral, timestamped folders: s3://redwood-evidence/extracts/2026-03-03/<control-id>/
- When redacting, save an unredacted package in secure vault (kms-encrypted) for internal review only.

Common auditor questions to prep answers for (rough Q&A):
- Q: How do you ensure dedicated capacity isolates customer A from B?
  - A: Dedicated pools are isolated at orchestration layer; infra network policies + tenant tagging on GPU nodes. Provide node tag snapshots and provisioning playbook.
- Q: How do you detect late-stage model rollouts that fail validation?
  - A: Rollout pipeline emits evaluation metrics to Console; have alert runbook and canary rollback automation (link to runbook).
- Q: How are admin privileges granted and revoked?
  - A: Short-lived access via IDP sessions, periodic attestation, and Jira approval records for permanent role changes.

Open POCs / experiments (to convert to formal artifacts):
- 2026-02-20: script to correlate Console trace id -> GitHub PR -> infra event (proof-of-correlation). Using trace tag 'pr_id' is helpful; demo script in /tmp/pr-trace-linker.py (todo: commit).
- 2026-02-27: baseline of total token-generation activity grouped by model variant for last 90 days (helps show billing/usage separation for dedicated customers). Need a runbook to pull from metrics DB.

Privacy/redaction reminders:
- Remove PII and customer prompt payloads unless explicitly requested by auditor and covered by NDA. Use synthetic examples instead.
- Keep single canonical redaction policy doc link in Confluence and reference it in every evidence package.

Next steps (my personal checklist):
- [ ] Commit pr-trace-linker script to infra repo (owner: Jin) (target 2026-03-05)
- [ ] Produce one control package for CC-Logging-04 with unredacted vault copy + redacted public export (owner: Ava)
- [ ] Draft short auditor-facing narrative for KeyMgmt with HSM attestation steps (owner: Noah)
- [ ] Sync with SRE on node tagging proof for Dedicated pools (meeting request)

Blockers / questions to resolve:
- Do we have an HSM attestation file for last year for on-prem customers? If not, need to collect from Customer Success/Professional Services.
- Need guidance from legal on sharing CloudTrail snippets that include customer tenant ids.
- How to show immutability for Hosted logs that may be server-side rotated (we rely on CloudWatch Logs with retention); auditors prefer S3 export with versioning.

Random scratch ideas (junk drawer):
- Could generate a tiny 'evidence index.json' in each package that lists artifacts and commands used to produce them — auditors like reproducibility.
- Consider adding a signed checksum file for each artifact (gpg or sigstore) to show tamper evidence.

References and quick links:
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-SEC-1723 (KMS/HSM playbook)
- Jira: JIRA-SEC-312 (evidence backlog)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/481
- Slack threads: #trust-evidence (search "trace-linker")

Endnotes: rough, noisy, intentionally ad-hoc. Move things that survive vetting into a proper package and link in Confluence.

-- Jin
